query.title: Company name
query.description: A business/company name (or partial name, at least 3 characters) to search for on Eswatini's official company register.

queries.title: Company names
queries.description: Multiple names to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched rows to return per search query. The register has no server-side pagination -- a broad query can legitimately return thousands of rows, so this caps how many are kept.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search queries to run in parallel. Keep this low -- broad queries can take the register's server 20-30 seconds to render.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
